editorial_changes: Preserved all seven main sections and all substantive reviewed-manuscript teaching; removed duplicate pre-sermon outline and stage directions, normalized paragraphs, headings and 姊妹.

Restored transcript-supported opening appearance question; church baptism/calling testimony practice; teaching theological students in China; reflection on renovation of a formerly pastored church. No new dates, financial amounts, names or circumstances invented.

Omitted unverified John Sung/Aquinas anecdotes; excluded transcript assertions that Genesis names a lamb or says weather changed after the Fall; avoided merging Nehemiah wall rebuilding with Zerubbabel temple rebuilding.

Preserved reviewed-manuscript qualifications concerning literal/symbolic witnesses and 1,260 days, spiritual gifts, authority to judge, olive-press illustration, and grace rather than earned salvation.
Added cross-references Jonah 3:4–8, Revelation 1:20, Matthew 5:44, Revelation 11:7.

English translates final Chinese prose faithfully; Scripture quotations use KJV rather than a back-translation of Chinese Union Version. Revelation 11:4 has CUV 世界之主 and KJV God of the earth; underlying sovereign-God argument is preserved.
